display.purpose: Hero name only. Stacked two-line nameplate. Never below the fold.

headline.purpose: Section titles and project page hero titles. Authoritative level.

title.purpose: Card headings, timeline roles, award titles, hobby titles.

body.purpose: All prose: about text, timeline bullets, project descriptions. 70ch line length cap.

label.purpose: Section eyebrow text. Always precedes a headline. Never standalone.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Cards in their default state. Soft containment without visual lift.

shadows.name: elevated-hover
shadows.purpose: Cards on hover. Always applied alongside transform: translateY(-4px to -8px). Never in isolation.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover only. A blue-tinted glow that reads as energised without being decorative.

shadows.name: nav-scrolled
shadows.purpose: Navbar after scroll. Slightly heavier than card shadows to pin the nav above content.

motion.name: standard-transition
motion.purpose: Default for all interactive element state changes: color, background, border, transform, box-shadow.

motion.name: fade-in-enter
motion.purpose: Section content fade-in on scroll. Elements begin at opacity 0 and translateY(24px).

motion.name: scroll-bounce
motion.purpose: Hero scroll indicator only. A simple keyframe: translateY(0) to translateY(8px) at 50%, back to 0. Disable under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Projects grid drops from 3-col to 2-col. Skills grid collapses.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Hero goes to single column. Most 2-col grids become 1-col. Navbar collapses to hamburger.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Awards and gallery grids go single column. Award cards stack vertically.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Used for 'See My Work' and 'View Project'. Process Signal Blue fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: #3B82F6; color: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2563EB; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(59,130,246,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3B82F6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA on dark/navy backgrounds. 'Get In Touch' in hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav CTA
components.description: Contact button in the navbar. Tighter padding, 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-block; background: #3B82F6; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.86rem; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #2563EB; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3B82F6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Clickable project card with image area, tag, title, description, and arrow link. Entire card is an anchor.
components.html:

Additive Manufacturing · PEEK

PEEK High-Temperature 3D Printer

Engineered a cost-effective FDM printer capable of extruding PEEK at extreme temperatures.

View Project →
components.css: .ds-project-card { display: block; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(15,39,68,0.10); transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(15,39,68,0.18); } .ds-project-img { height: 200px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-project-img-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F2744 0%, #1E3A5F 100%); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; } .ds-project-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-project-tag { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3B82F6; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; } .ds-project-title { font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0F2744; margin: 10px 0; line-height: 1.3; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; } .ds-project-desc { font-size: 0.84rem; color: #4A5568; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-project-link { font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3B82F6; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transition: gap 0.3s ease; } .ds-project-card:hover .ds-project-link { gap: 8px; } .ds-project-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3B82F6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skill Tag
components.description: Pill tag for skills. Off-white background by default, inverts to Midnight Ore on hover.
components.css: .ds-skill-tag { display: inline-block; background: #F7F9FC; color: #4A5568; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1px solid #EDF2F7; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; cursor: default; } .ds-skill-tag:hover { background: #0F2744; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #0F2744; }

components.name: Award Badge
components.description: Recognition chip used exclusively on award card entries. Gold for awards, Ore Mid for publications.
components.css: .ds-award-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 50px; background: #C5A028; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-award-badge.pub { background: #1E3A5F; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Uppercase label that precedes every section headline. Process Signal Blue, no background.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3B82F6; margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: 2x2 grid of achievement metrics in the About section. Top-accent stripe, centered metric + label.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; padding: 28px 20px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(15,39,68,0.10); border-top: 4px solid #3B82F6; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-stat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(15,39,68,0.18); } .ds-stat-number { display: block; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0F2744; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-stat-label { display: block; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #718096; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview:
This design system reads like a document written by the person who did the work — not by an agency hired to sell them. The aesthetic is built on a committed navy field that dominates the primary surfaces (hero, education, contact), offset by a tightly controlled signal accent and the specific warmth of a person who has actually shipped things. Every typographic choice, every spacing decision, and every color appears because it is earning something: credibility, hierarchy, or connection.

The palette is committed, not restrained. Midnight Ore covers more than half the site's total surface area across three full-bleed sections. This is intentional. The navy isn't a brand color applied tastefully; it is the environment the reader enters. Process Signal Blue appears only where it means something: active links, call-to-action buttons, company names in timeline entries, and section eyebrows. Its restraint is the point. Commendation Gold appears exactly twice — on award badges — and should never be extended to other uses.

Motion is minimal and functional: fade-in on scroll for content sections, translate-up on card hover for tactile feedback, nothing choreographed, nothing ambient. The site should feel like it responds to you, not performs at you.
keyCharacteristics: Committed navy palette; Midnight Ore is the dominant surface, not an accent
Single signal accent (Process Signal Blue) used to mean 'active' or 'interactive'
Commendation Gold is reserved exclusively for recognition and award elements
Raleway for all display and heading hierarchy; Open Sans for body prose
Cards lift on hover; sections fade in on scroll; no bounce, no elastic easing
Typography hierarchy built on weight contrast (400 body / 700 title / 800 display)
Prose line length capped at approximately 70ch in body sections

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Process Signal Blue appears on fewer than 15% of any light-background screen. It is the indicator light on a control panel; if it's everywhere, it means nothing.

rules.name: The Gold Lock Rule
rules.body: Commendation Gold (#C5A028) is locked to award and recognition contexts. It does not appear on buttons, decorative elements, dividers, hover states, or section accents of any kind.

rules.name: The Raleway Boundary Rule
rules.body: Open Sans is prose only. Navigation, headings, labels, badges, captions, section eyebrows, and CTA buttons use Raleway. Never use Open Sans for UI text.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: A minimum step of one full weight level (200 points) between hierarchy levels in close proximity. Body at 400, title at 700, headline at 800.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No resting shadow on the hero image frame. Shadows are earned by interaction.

rules.name: The Navy Tint Rule
rules.body: All shadows use rgba(15,39,68,...) as the shadow base, not rgba(0,0,0,...). A black shadow on a navy-heavy site looks like a different product.

dos: Do use Midnight Ore for full-bleed hero, education, and contact sections.
Do keep Process Signal Blue to interactive and semantic roles only.
Do animate cards with transform: translateY and the matched shadow change together.
Do cap body text columns at approximately 70ch.
Do use Raleway at weight 800 for all display and section headline text.
Do match shadow tint to Midnight Ore (rgba(15,39,68,...)), not black.
Do reserve Commendation Gold exclusively for the awards section and recognition badges.
donts: Don't add a third accent color.
Don't use an identical card grid with same structure repeated endlessly.
Don't add decorative animations, entrance choreography, or ambient motion.
Don't use a dark hacker / terminal aesthetic.
Don't let the design drift into corporate grey sterility.
Don't use generic Bootstrap-style card grids or template navy-plus-card-grid layouts.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a standalone colored accent on new components.
Don't animate height, width, padding, margin, or layout properties.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
